timeline.text: Twice this month a video digest stalled for hours - August 18th and 21st - and nobody noticed until someone happened to check.
There was no retry - a stuck draft just sat there.
Now narration and scenario come straight from my own Claude subscription, not a free AI cascade.
A watchdog checks every 30 minutes and wakes the pipeline the moment a draft sticks.
That exact stall - the cause of both gaps - now heals itself within 30 minutes.
